wrapper: mise-bound Bun -> bash time -> normal root script

methods.formalGate: Three serial invocations of the normal public root command. No cache clearing or policy change. Normal history updates remain. All selected Check IDs compared exactly.
methods.cpu: bash time user/system covers the command process tree; cgroup counters also include other workspace processes. Throttled microseconds are not wall time saved.
methods.timeline: Derived from observed diagnostic admission/settlement boundaries (millisecond text precision); summary values are native measurements, not recomputed. Waiting with a free root slot is not proof that filling it improves elapsed time.
methods.isolated: Three sequential public API Runs in each new process, same installed candidate and exact Gate Check options, output disabled; Bun --cpu-prof-md at default 1000us sampling. These are not formal Gate timings or before/after tests.
methods.collection: Public collectProjectFiles with exact resolved Check selection. fs.readdirSync pass-through observer counts directories and returned regular-file entries; no pruning or output substitution.
methods.phases: Installed-candidate module exports wrapped by bun:test mock.module; original functions execute unchanged. Function measurement zero-delay timers call the original setTimeout and callback; an observer accumulates actual delay. Instrumentation and profiler runs are different workloads.
limitations: No alternate scheduler execution, cache configuration experiment, source change, or baseline change.
Function CPU profile samples the parent, not a full Worker CPU breakdown; async profile attribution is not treated as response-validation cost.
Nested phase timings overlap. Check-slot time, queue time, cgroup throttling, and wall time are different metrics.
Only three formal observations; no reliable cross-run Gate-duration P95 or causal attribution of all variance.

formalSamples.observerRecoveryNote: Gate completed normally; observation wrapper then failed while treating a test-created diagnostic directory as a primary Gate. Shell timing and Gate evidence retained; lost wrapper wall/cgroup deltas are not reconstructed.

markdownLinkValidation.caveat: Pass-through instrumented installed candidate; nested category timings overlap and must not be summed.
